theAccuracyProblem:
GETTING HALAL STATUS WRONG IS NOT A RANKING ERROR, IT IS A HARM. A reader who eats somewhere on the strength of this guide is relying on it for a religious dietary requirement. Every other topic on this site fails softly - a mediocre pizza recommendation wastes an evening. This one does not.

THREE STATUSES THAT SOURCES ROUTINELY CONFLATE:
  1. HALAL CERTIFIED - a certifying body (HMC, HFA) has audited it. Verifiable.
  2. HALAL MEAT, UNCERTIFIED - the kitchen sources halal meat and says so, with no third-party audit. Common and legitimate, but it is the venue's own claim.
  3. HALAL-FRIENDLY / HALAL OPTIONS - some dishes only, or no pork, which is NOT the same thing.

A guide that prints all three as 'halal' is wrong in a way that matters. CARRY THE STATUS PER VENUE, sourced to who says it, and never upgrade a venue's own claim into a certification.

SERVING ALCOHOL is a separate axis again and readers differ on whether it disqualifies a room. Record it; do not rule on it.

VERIFY AT THE VENUE, NOT THE LIST. A listicle saying 'halal' is not evidence. The venue's own site, or a certifier's register, is. Where neither confirms it, say the status is unconfirmed rather than guessing.
theAccuracyProblemConfirmed:
THE 2026-09-07 SOURCE PASS PROVED THIS SECTION RIGHT, TWICE, IN THE FIRST PAGE OF RESULTS.

yalla-london.com states that Hakkasan, Zuma and Novikov are 'all with halal-certified menus'. That is false. Its sister page softens the same claim to 'Zuma: Japanese fine dining with halal meat options (confirm when booking)' - status 3 sold under a 'Best Halal Restaurants' headline. The domain is excluded below.

havehalalwilltravel.com writes 'Dishoom is verified halal!' and lists Poppies Fish and Chips - which serves sausages and alcohol - as a Muslim-friendly eatery. Its per-venue 'Halal status:' lines are the most useful thing found anywhere in this pass AND its headline claims are the least reliable. Both facts are true at once.

So: the status axis cannot be lifted from ANY list in the corpus, including the good ones. It has to be built venue by venue from the venue's own site or a certifier's register. Budget for that separately from source collection.
theCountingProblem:
THE AGGREGATOR PROBLEM IS WORSE HERE THAN ANYWHERE. The first page of results is almost entirely SEO content farms - bestcafes.co.uk, vyapargrow.com, thatsup.co.uk - carrying near-identical lists with no evidence anyone visited. These are trap 8 furniture with a venue-shaped surface, and recording them would inflate the source count while contributing nothing. Excluded on sight below.

SECOND: CHAINS. Dishoom and Comptoir Libanais appear on most lists. Both are multi-branch and NOT uniformly halal across branches, which is exactly the kind of per-branch fact a chain row must carry rather than the brand.

THIRD: CHECK indian.json, turkish.json AND chinese.json FIRST (trap 13). A large share of London's halal restaurants are already recorded under a cuisine topic. Grep every consensus file for a URL before adding it. DONE 2026-09-07 - see theOverlapFinding.

TRAP 13 CHECKED 2026-09-07. NO URL COLLISION: none of the eight seed URLs in data/serp/halal.txt appears in indian.json, turkish.json, chinese.json, middle-eastern.json or pakistani.json. Safe to seed.

TRAP 7 IS THE LIVE RISK, NOT DUPLICATION. A venue may legitimately sit in both corpora - halal is a certification cutting across cuisines, so Tayyabs belongs to pakistani AND halal. What must NOT happen is printing a venue's indian.json or pakistani.json citation count in the halal guide. evidence.json records `topics`; check topics.includes('halal') before printing any number. The halal corpus must be built from halal sources only and counted on its own.

FALSE POSITIVES in the grep, ignore them: 'Heritage' matches the ordinary word across british/historic-houses/london-with-children/unusual; 'Emirates' matches Emirates Stadium in activities.json.

assessedAndExcluded.verdict: EXCLUDE. The previous config flagged two overlapping pages as possible trap 16. IT IS WORSE THAN TRAP 16 AND IT IS NOT TRAP 16.
assessedAndExcluded.finding:
NOT one page under two URLs - the two flagged pages have DISJOINT name arrays (fine-dining page: Ours, Boisdale of Belgravia, Hawksmoor; Michelin page: Gymkhana, Brigadiers, Darjeeling Express). So the trap-16 test comes back negative.

What it actually is: a programmatic-SEO doorway network of AT LEAST NINE overlapping halal pages on one domain - /halal-restaurants-london, /ar/halal-restaurants-london (Arabic mirror), /information/articles/halal-dining-london-guide, /information/articles/best-halal-restaurants-london, /blog/best-halal-restaurants-london-for-muslims, /blog/best-halal-restaurants-central-london-2025, /blog/best-halal-michelin-star-restaurants-london, /blog/best-halal-fine-dining-restaurants-london-vnh5h, /blog/halal-restaurants-london-luxury-guide-befe83d8. Two of those slugs end in Wix auto-generated hashes.

WHY IT FAILS THE BLOG TEST, in order of severity:
  1. IT IS FACTUALLY DANGEROUS. Claims Hakkasan, Zuma and Novikov are 'all with halal-certified menus'.
  2. PARENT MONETISATION IS HOTEL BOOKING, not food - Expedia and Vrbo affiliate blocks with a commission disclosure, which is the README's named tell.
  3. Fabricated-looking round statistics: '700+ halal-certified restaurants', '200+ Lebanese', '300+ South Asian', '150+ Turkish'.
  4. A related-article headline on the site is a raw keyword string left unedited: "novikov London" "not Currently Listed In The Michelin".
  5. Bylines are either the house name or 'Sarah Al-Rashid, Luxury Hotels & Gulf Travel Editor', a masthead title no site this size has.
  6. The /halal-restaurants-london page has no per-venue prose at all - just neighbourhood tag clusters.
SO: excluded, not tier C. Do not seed any yalla-london URL.

theSourceMixVerdict:
ASKED AND ANSWERED 2026-09-07: NO, THIS TOPIC CANNOT MEET THE METHOD'S FLOOR IN THIS ENVIRONMENT. Do not collect and publish as though it can.

THE FLOOR: no judged award exists for this topic (see knownGaps), so SKILL.md requires THREE independent social voices - tier D video and tier E community.

WHAT THIS PASS CAN DELIVER: 8 sources, 8 distinct domains. ONE tier B (Time Out) and SEVEN tier C. ZERO tier A. ZERO tier D. ZERO tier E. Social voices available: 0 of 3.

EXACTLY WHAT IS MISSING, AND WHAT WOULD FIX IT:
  1. TIER D (video) - blocked because APIFY_TOKEN is not set. Setting it unblocks this immediately. Halal food is one of the most heavily filmed London subjects on TikTok and YouTube, so this is the cheapest and largest single win available. It alone would take the topic from 0 of 3 to 2 or 3 of 3.
  2. TIER E (community) - Reddit is blocked to curl AND to the browser pane here. NOT fixable from this environment. Only route is Rob pasting thread URLs by hand, which SKILL.md explicitly provides for.
  3. TIER A - genuinely does not exist. Nothing to fix. See knownGaps.

AND ONE MORE THING THE AUDIT WILL NOT CATCH: SEVEN OF EIGHT SOURCES ARE TIER C. The audit-source-mix script flags a topic that is over 70% SOCIAL; it does not flag one that is 87% independent blogs. That is a thin, one-shaped corpus and this file should say so even though no script will.

RECOMMENDATION: set APIFY_TOKEN and run the video tier BEFORE collecting, not after. Otherwise ask Rob before proceeding - per ask-dont-publish-gaps, the gap goes to him, never onto the page.

NO SOURCE IN THIS CORPUS PUBLISHES A CURRENT QUALITY RANKING, and section 1 of the article shape ('The winners - the venues that actually top a ranking') therefore has nothing to lead with.

  Time Out          numbered 1-18, but the caption reads unordered. Probably no ranks.
  DesignMyNight     grouped by cuisine. No ranks.
  Secret London     numbered 1-15, curated sequence. No ranks.
  Halal Girl        no ranks.

So the two ordered sources are one stale and one out-of-scope. SKILL.md forbids sorting section 1 by citation count as a substitute. This needs a structural decision from a human BEFORE the article is drafted: either lead on Feed the Lion's London-scoped subset and say what it is, or drop section 1 and open on widest agreement. Do not invent an order.

formatSection.note: THE MOST IMPORTANT SECTION IN THIS GUIDE and no competitor prints it. Split every venue by which of the three statuses it holds, with the source for each. A reader who needs certification and a reader who is content with a kitchen's own word are making different decisions.
formatSection.howToBuildItAfterThisPass: CONFIRMED 2026-09-07 THAT NO SOURCE IN THE CORPUS CAN SUPPLY THIS. Only havehalalwilltravel.com prints a per-venue status line at all, it is excluded, and its lines are wrong at the headline anyway. Every other source either says nothing or says 'halal' flat. So this section is a separate research job against venue sites and the HMC and HFA registers, venue by venue, after collection. Budget for it. Where neither confirms, print 'unconfirmed' - do not guess, and do not let a listicle's word become a certification.

knownGaps: NO JUDGED BRITISH HALAL RESTAURANT AWARD EXISTS. RESOLVED 2026-09-07, and the answer is no. Three candidates checked: (1) 'British Halal Food Awards' - the name the previous config guessed at - HAS NO WEBSITE. Its entire web presence is a Facebook page, so there is no published, dated, judged results page. Not tier A. (2) ISLAM CHANNEL AWARDS is genuinely judged - 20 named judges chaired by Sir Iqbal Sacranie OBE, two judges per entry, a five-finalist shortlist, final interviews in April - but its food category is 'Food & Beverage BUSINESS of the Year', a single UK-wide business prize, and it publishes NO restaurant names at all. Not a restaurant ranking, not tier A for this topic. (3) BRITISH MUSLIM AWARDS (Oceanic Awards, 13th edition, May 2026, Wolverhampton) is a community-achievement award for people and organisations, publicly nominated, UK-wide. Not tier A. CONCLUSION: tier A is empty and cannot be filled. Do not record any of these three as an award.

TIER E (community) CANNOT be collected here - Reddit is blocked to curl and to the browser pane. This is the worst topic on the site to lose it: r/london and the halal food communities are where per-branch certification is actually discussed. Only fix is Rob pasting thread URLs by hand.

TIER D (video) needs APIFY_TOKEN, NOT set. Halal food is very heavily filmed on TikTok and YouTube, and losing that tier removes the sources closest to the community the guide is for. THIS IS THE ONE BLOCKER THAT IS TRIVIALLY FIXABLE and it is worth fixing before collection rather than after.
